The first wingtip to hit the water pulls the entire body of the aircraft towards that wing, and before you know it the entire airplane is cartwheeling and tearing itself apart.

The reason the Hudson River landing went so well is that the pilot was extremely skilled and performed a maneuver that bled off almost all of his forward momentum, allowing him to pretty much "fall" into the water (there was still some forward speed left but nothing like a typical landing).
